name: Alu Kurumba
world_status: a description exists but is not accessible
sweep_summary: The only stress-title item for Alu Kurumba is a Glottolog mis-assignment: Bell 2012, a Cambridge PhD thesis on English noun-noun compound prosody, linked to xua by Glottolog's own 'computerized assignment from \"nn\"' (verified on the Glottolog record and the author's ARU profile; no open copy exists, Apollo 0 hits, no Crossref DOI). It says nothing about Alu Kurumba and needs no acquisition. No first-hand Alu Kurumba word-stress statement was read in this sweep. Leads remain those already on file from the earlier pass in the same directory: Kapp 1982 (Alu-Kurumbaru Nayan, Harrassowitz) pp. 41-50 on syllable/word structure and accent per Zvelebil's 1988 IJDL review (second-hand, no rule stated; HathiTrust search-only copy mdp.39015001170227 still Cloudflare-403 from our machine), and Emeneau 1997 in Hockings ed. Blue Mountains Revisited pp. 101-102 ('In quoting Alu Kurumba forms I have omitted accent markings, which are in general placed...'), whose continuation I again could not recover via archive.org full-text search (lending-only item; page-break cut; new probe receipts saved as search_receipts/). in updated with the sweep lines. all lookups were done with direct fetches and API calls.

sources.note: p.157: Kapp 'deals with the structure of syllables and words, and with the problems of accent which plays, apparently, a rather important role in Alu Kurumba (certainly more important than in the related Irula), cf. pp. 41-50.' Locates Kapp's accent section (Kapp 1982 pp. 41-50, inside phonetics/phonology pp. 3-50) but states no rule.
